name: Yamanaka Shoutarou
source:
Hobbies: Training
Skills: Making rice balls
Likes: Puns, adventures, love
Dislikes: People coming down the stairs (and vice versa)
Favorite food: Rice
Hated food: Mud dumpling ([url=/c17263]Chinami[/url] once forced him to taste this)

The protagonist of the story. He loves cooking and has high physical abilities, but hates and can't study nor take his studies seriously. Shotarou is well-known in the academy for causing the most incidents, but to most people he is a good guy. Shotarou has only one goal in his life and this is why he came to Renren Academy: to find himself a girlfriend.
